canonical_title: Nvidia H200 inventory in Hong Kong awaiting China import approval
treatment: Repeat only for official import approval, inventory movement, confirmed quantities, or material policy change.
known_facts: Reuters exclusive published 2026-11-05 11:27 UTC reports approximately 600,000 H200 chips stored in Hong Kong pending mainland China import approval, based on anonymous sources.
China has reportedly permitted limited quantities but not large-scale H200 imports; no official confirmation of stockpile quantity.
reinclude_only_if: Official Chinese import decision or new material independently verified shipment or supply data.
notes: Reuters exclusive; 20:27 JST publication; source claims not official inventory audit.
